data.name: Meenakshii
data.long_meaning: Meenakshi is a form of Goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva. Her name is derived from the words 'meena' (fish) and 'akshi' (eye). She is believed to have the power to bestow her devotees with love, wisdom, and wealth. In Hindu mythology, she is also known as the 'War Goddess' for her fierce and unyielding nature.
